today.theme: Talk naturally about where you work best
today.source: BBC Learning English — Real Easy English: Talking about the office
today.listen_task: First pass: note each speaker's work arrangement and one reason they prefer the office or home. With the transcript, notice how they compare options without sounding too formal.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, tell a colleague where you work best and why. Then ask: ‘What works best for you?’

phrases.phrase: I usually work from home, but ...
phrases.note: Describe a regular pattern, then add an exception or preference.
Explain which setting helps you focus or work efficiently.

phrases.phrase: It depends on what I'm working on.
phrases.note: Give a balanced answer instead of choosing one option absolutely.
